correctness.rationale: The probability coefficient is independently reconstructed by an exact wedge-Jacobian calculation; centered-chord direction has the C1-uniform expansion phi(c)+delta^2 kappa_prime(c)/24+O(delta^4). Subtraction yields beta=delta*kappa+delta^3*kappa_doubleprime/12+O(delta^5). Expanding beta/sin(beta)-1, periodic quadrature, and integration by parts produce the stated O(m^-4) expansion. The support-function family has positive radius of curvature, equal pointwise curvature histograms under arclength, and exact coefficients with opposite signs. Standard-library numerical verifier agrees and is not substituted for proof.

This supplies a natural structural inverse-geometric distinction, not a routine numeric increment.
